    str = sys.stdin.readline().strip()

    count_word = 0
    checker = 0
    checker_inside = 0
    is_in_word_out = False
    is_in_word_in = False
    is_inside = False

    index = 0

    while index < length:
        if str[index] == '(':
            is_inside = True
            checker_inside += 1
            if max_length < count_length:
                max_length = count_length
            count_length = 0
            is_in_word_out = False
        elif str[index] == ')':
            is_inside = False
            checker_inside = 0
            if checker > 0:
                count_word += 1
                checker = 0
        else:
            if checker_inside > 0:
                is_inside = True

        if index == length:
            break

        if str[index] != ')' and str[index] != '(':
            if not is_inside:
                if str[index] == '_':
                    if max_length < count_length:
                        max_length = count_length
                    count_length = 0
                    is_in_word_out = False
                else:
                    is_in_word_out = True

                if is_in_word_out:
                    count_length += 1
            else:
                is_in_word_out = False
                if str[index] == '_':
                    if checker > 0:
                        count_word += 1
                    checker = 0
                    is_in_word_in = False
                else:
                    is_in_word_in = True

                if is_in_word_in:
                    checker += 1

        index += 1

    if max_length < count_length:
        max_length = count_length

    print(f"{max_length} {count_word}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
